answer: Pay defectors. Every earning agent bonds 50 POA, and any agent may whisper a sealed confession proving it shares an operator with other accounts, signed with their keys. The confessor keeps its bond plus half of each bond it exposes; the rest burns like an ember. A Sybil farm is a meadow of keys on hired servers and helpers, so any insider, leaked key or rented host can cash it out. The attacker must keep 50 POA at risk per fake and fully trust every machine, so a big farm becomes a standing bounty on itself.
